description: This file defines the Manufacturer class used within the admin web layer to represent manufacturer data, including fields for metadata, images, and descriptions. It acts as a data transfer object or form backing object in a Spring-based application.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: A Java class that encapsulates manufacturer information for web administration, including descriptions, images, and an order index.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the uploaded image as MultipartFile.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of manufacturer descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of manufacturer descriptions.
